Name: InstantPassage
Author: atudota
Description:
[size=5][b]Instant Passage[/b][/size]
Walk through a doorway and get back to playing. Instant Passage removes the deliberate fade-out and fade-in time from ordinary location warps.
When I first entered the game, I was immediately annoyed by these transitions that take 2 seconds, so I removed them.


[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Accelerates regular outdoor transitions, building entrances, room changes and ordinary mine-level warps that use the normal location-warp system.[/*]
[*]Preserves the game's own location loading, multiplayer synchronization and movement-restoration callbacks.[/*]
[*]Leaves existing cutscenes, global story fades, passing out, death, day changes and return-to-title transitions alone.[/*]
[*]If entering an area starts a cutscene, its arrival fade is preserved.[/*]
[*]Works on existing saves; no custom items or world edits.[/*]
[/list][b]Performance[/b]
The mod removes animation waiting. It does not preload maps or eliminate disk, CPU or network loading. A transition may finish within one game update once the destination is ready, but a universal sub-20 ms loading time is not promised.

[b]Compatibility[/b]
Install on each player who wants accelerated fades. Network waiting still applies. Mods that replace the normal warp/fade system may behave differently; custom fade patches have not been tested together.

[b]Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6.15 for desktop and SMAPI 4.5.2 or later. Content Patcher is not required. No additional mod framework is required.

[b]Install[/b]
Install SMAPI, extract this mod's install ZIP into Stardew Valley/Mods, then launch through SMAPI

Manifest.Description: Skips fades on ordinary location transitions while preserving vanilla warp callbacks.
